Gideon closed out ticket **#8841** with support on 1 July, per his post in #strategic-pod that morning. The fix was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for Vantorre's billing team.

One caveat: a 30 September digest also links #8841 to a Door 14 kiosk problem, and dates it to after 1 July. I can't tell from the brain alone whether that's the same ticket, so it's worth checking the ticket itself.
